text:
ConocoPhillips stock rose 0.26% today to $134.54, continuing a sharp rally that has added 5.69% over two weeks. The immediate driver is a perfect storm for oil producers: Hurricane Isaias is disrupting U.S. Gulf of Mexico production and threatening refineries, while simultaneous geopolitical tension—Iran-backed Houthis attacking Saudi infrastructure and the Trump administration considering military action against Iran—has pushed world oil prices to $125.44 per barrel, up sharply from typical levels. For an integrated oil major like ConocoPhillips, both tighter supply and higher global crude prices expand profit margins.

The 2-week rally reflects how quickly market conditions have shifted in oil's favor. Just days ago, crude was trading lower; the cascade of production outages, tanker attacks, and escalating U.S.-Iran tensions since October 8th has reversed that, signaling investors expect sustained pressure on global supply into the near term.
